utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it’s still happening — I’m keeping it on the calendar. I’ll check in with the others and make sure we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — can you confirm the time once you hear back?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have any repair-drive locations yet, but I’m keeping track. If you want, I can help map out the spots we still need to cover.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Opal — let’s map out the spots we still need to cover.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—I’ve got the repair drive list organized and ready. What do you want me to prioritize first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—could you start with the biggest safety repairs first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll put the biggest safety repairs at the top and get those moving first. I’ll keep you posted as I work through the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is happening soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I could use a ladder and a good drill if anyone’s got one to lend. I’m happy to help wherever you need an extra set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can ask around for a ladder and drill, and I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’d like to start by sorting the donated tools and seeing what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and repeat the plan to everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — that’ll help keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli, the repair drive’s coming up soon — want me to put you on the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please put me on the list. Just let me know the time and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put you on the list and let you know the time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren — we still need a few hands for sorting donations and loading up the boxes. If you can swing by later, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—once I know the time, I can plan around pickup and bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh good, I was just out running errands—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s moving along—still collecting what people can spare, and I’m keeping it pretty simple. If you’ve got anything to drop off, I can point you to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I can swing by and drop something off later. Just point me to the right spot when I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—what changed? I must’ve missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly just the date and a couple of the drop-off details changed. I can fill you in if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please—what’s the new date and where should folks drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Cleo—what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina—please bring duct tape, zip ties, and any spare screws you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I’ll bring duct tape, zip ties, and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the schedule and where the repairs are happening first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard it’s starting later this week, but I don’t know the exact times yet. I can ask around and let you know where they’re doing the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help. Please let me know the exact times and locations when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still happening — I’m happy to lend a hand with tools if needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive. What time are we starting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re starting at 9:00 a.m. by the community shed, and please bring sturdy gloves, a screwdriver, and any spare screws you have.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. I’ll be there at 9:00 with gloves, a screwdriver, and a few spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to chip in where they can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep nudging people and make sure they know every bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rosa, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive — want me to put your name down or bring you the details?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — please put my name down and bring me the details. I’d love to help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put your name down and bring you the details soon. We’ll make a great little team spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably join a bit late, but I can still help out with the repair drive. Let me know what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Dane — if you can bring a drill and a few screwdrivers, that would help a lot. I’ll keep a spot for you when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: You got it — I’ll bring a drill and a few screwdrivers. Thanks for saving me a spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I’ll need to keep it brief today. What’s the next thing you want me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you bring the extension cords and check the side gate latch? If you only have a few minutes, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that. I’ll bring the extension cords and take a quick look at the side gate latch.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Could you bring a roll of duct tape and a few screwdrivers? That’d help us a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring duct tape and a few screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list for the repair drive—what do we still need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m ready to jot down whatever’s missing—just tell me the list, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need me to coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — could you coordinate volunteers for tool sorting and a quick intake table? I can handle the supply list and drop-off setup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll line up volunteers for tool sorting and the intake table. If you have any timing details, send them my way and I’ll start reaching out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey—could you bring a screwdriver and maybe some extra tape? I’m a bit scattered today, so that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll bring a screwdriver and extra tape.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the exact list, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll confirm the details and get back to you with what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just let me know when you’ve confirmed it, and I’ll help.
